display.purpose: Rare moments only, such as a character name.

title.purpose: Emphasis inside a speech bubble, tool-result headings.

body.purpose: Speech text as short conversational bursts in a narrow bubble column.

label.purpose: Tool status and timestamps, light uppercase tracking.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: The single soft ambient layer under every floating surface.

shadows.name: text-shadow
shadows.purpose: Keeps light text legible over a bright backdrop.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default ease-out exponential curve for all transitions; no bounce or elastic.

motion.name: dwell
motion.purpose: Hold time after an utterance settles.

components.name: Speech Bubble
components.description: The primary floating caption surface: dark scrim, light warm text, single ambient shadow, the only sanctioned frosted backdrop.
components.html: Hey, you're deep in the dispatcher. Want a hand with that classify branch?
components.css: .ds-speech-bubble { max-width: min(34ch, 78%); padding: 0.7rem 0.95rem; border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(0.21 0.014 70 / 0.64); border: 1px solid oklch(0.97 0.01 80 / 0.1); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px oklch(0.12 0.02 70 / 0.4); backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.1); color: oklch(0.95 0.012 80); font: 400 0.95rem/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.1 0.01 70 / 0.55); text-wrap: pretty; } .ds-speech-bubble a { color: oklch(0.95 0.012 80); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: oklch(0.8 0.13 75 / 0.45); text-underline-offset: 0.18em; text-decoration-thickness: 0.08em; transition: color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), text-decoration-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-speech-bubble a:hover, .ds-speech-bubble a:focus-visible { color: oklch(0.8 0.13 75); text-decoration-color: oklch(0.8 0.13 75); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Slim field summoned by hotkey; hairline border at rest, ignites to an amber border plus ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-text-input { display: flex; align-items: center; width: min(42ch, 84%); padding: 0.1rem; border-radius: 12px; background: oklch(0.19 0.014 70 / 0.82); border: 1px solid oklch(0.97 0.01 80 / 0.1); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px oklch(0.12 0.02 70 / 0.4); transition: border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-text-input:focus-within { border-color: oklch(0.8 0.13 75); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px oklch(0.12 0.02 70 / 0.4), 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.8 0.13 75 / 0.45); } .ds-text-input input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 0.55rem 0.7rem; border: 0; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.95 0.012 80); font: 400 0.95rem/1.4 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.1 0.01 70 / 0.55); } .ds-text-input input:focus { outline: none; } .ds-text-input input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.78 0.016 75); opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Tool-status Chip
components.description: Low-emphasis pill shown while the backend runs a tool; calm opacity dot-pulse, no amber.
components.css: .ds-tool-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.28rem 0.7rem; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.21 0.014 70 / 0.64); border: 1px solid oklch(0.97 0.01 80 / 0.1); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px oklch(0.12 0.02 70 / 0.4); color: oklch(0.78 0.016 75); font: 500 0.75rem/1 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; white-space: nowrap; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.1 0.01 70 / 0.55); } .ds-tool-status__dot { width: 0.42rem; height: 0.42rem; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(0.78 0.016 75); animation: ds-tool-pulse 1.4s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-tool-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.35; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }

components.name: Settings Row + Switch
components.description: Quick-controls list row with a label, sub-line, and a switch that ignites to a full amber track when on.
components.html:
주도적 반응
다른 앱을 쓸 때도 가끔 먼저 말을 걸어요
components.css: .ds-settings-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.55rem; border-radius: 10px; color: oklch(0.95 0.012 80); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-settings-row:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0.01 80 / 0.05); } .ds-settings-row__main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-settings-row__label { font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 550; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-settings-row__sub { margin-top: 0.18rem; font-size: 0.74rem; line-height: 1.35; color: oklch(0.66 0.014 72); } .ds-switch { position: relative; flex: 0 0 auto; width: 2.5rem; height: 1.45rem; border: 0; padding: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.5 0.01 70 / 0.35); cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-switch::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0.18rem; left: 0.18rem; width: 1.09rem; height: 1.09rem; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(0.96 0.01 80); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px oklch(0.1 0.01 70 / 0.5); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-switch[aria-checked='true'] { background: oklch(0.8 0.13 75); } .ds-switch[aria-checked='true']::after { transform: translateX(1.05rem); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.8 0.13 75 / 0.45); }

components.name: Capture Indicator
components.description: Always-on privacy tell that resides at the top edge while the screen is being attached; amber pulse dot.
components.html: 화면 보는 중
components.css: .ds-capture { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.46rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.66rem 0.3rem 0.56rem; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.21 0.014 70 / 0.64); border: 1px solid oklch(0.97 0.01 80 / 0.1); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px oklch(0.12 0.02 70 / 0.4); backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.1); color: oklch(0.78 0.016 75); font: 500 0.76rem/1 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; white-space: nowrap; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.1 0.01 70 / 0.55); } .ds-capture__live { width: 0.4rem; height: 0.4rem; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(0.8 0.13 75); animation: ds-capture-live 1.8s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-capture-live { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.45; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }

components.name: Voice Indicator
components.description: Runtime voice tell paired with the capture indicator; dot pulses amber while listening, green on fired, red on error.
components.css: .ds-voice { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.44rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.64rem 0.3rem 0.58rem; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.21 0.014 70 / 0.64); border: 1px solid oklch(0.97 0.01 80 / 0.1); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px oklch(0.12 0.02 70 / 0.4); backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.1); color: oklch(0.78 0.016 75); font: 500 0.76rem/1 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; white-space: nowrap; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.1 0.01 70 / 0.55); } .ds-voice__dot { width: 0.42rem; height: 0.42rem; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(0.8 0.13 75); animation: ds-voice-live 1.25s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-voice-live { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }

narrative.overview: YUI's interface is the dying embers of a fireplace: it burns warmly in a corner of the room without stealing the gaze. The character owns the stage; the chrome lights up only when it has something to say, then recedes into the dark. Color is near-achromatic neutral, warmth carried by a single point of amber. Type is a warm humanist sans; motion is feedback, never choreography. The whole system's purpose is to step back. Every surface floats over an arbitrary desktop background in a transparent, always-on-top window, so each must be legible against any backdrop without a heavy container. The surfaces that ever appear (speech bubble, text input, tool-status chip, capture and voice indicators) are the system's entirety and its signature. This system explicitly rejects the bottom-right SaaS chatbot widget, the messenger chat list, and the pushy speech bubbles of the old desktop mascot.
keyCharacteristics: Invisible-by-default: chrome is absent at rest; the character and desktop fill the stage.
Warm-when-present: when a surface appears, a small amber warmth meets humanist warmth.
Legible-on-anything: readable over any background through self-contrast, not the backdrop.
Calm motion: feedback transitions only, no choreography, quietly attenuated under reduced-motion.

rules.name: The 10% Warmth Rule
rules.body: Hearth Amber occupies ≤10% of any surface. Scarcity is the warmth; once common it reads as branding and breaks invisible-by-default.

rules.name: The Legible-on-Anything Rule
rules.body: Every text-bearing surface owns its contrast (dark scrim + light text + self-shadow). Legibility never depends on the desktop background.

rules.name: The Speech-First Rule
rules.body: Body type is tuned for short conversational bursts inside a bubble. Document layout rules (long measure, dense columns) are never imported.

rules.name: The Float Rule
rules.body: A surface floats with exactly one soft ambient shadow. Multiple shadows, hard drop shadows, and neon glows are forbidden.

dos: Do micro-tint every neutral toward amber (chroma ~0.005–0.016) in OKLCH; never #000/#fff.
Do keep Hearth Amber ≤10% of a surface, ignited only in moments (active input, speech onset, hover).
Do give a floating surface its own dark scrim plus light text for legibility on any background, and only where legibility is needed (the speech bubble), never decoratively.
Do keep motion Responsive: smooth enter/exit and feedback on an ease-out exponential curve, attenuated under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do stay flat, adding the single Float shadow only when a surface lifts.
donts: Don't look like an enterprise SaaS chatbot widget (bordered card, gradient accent, generic widget tone).
Don't stack chat lists, message rows, or channel chrome like a messenger app; YUI keeps no conversation log.
Don't use pushy, garish speech bubbles like an old desktop mascot, the exact opposite of non-intrusive.
Don't overuse glassmorphism: the frosted backdrop is purposeful in the one speech bubble only, otherwise skip it.
Don't use side-stripe borders (a color line >1px on an edge), gradient text (background-clip: text), identical card grids, or modal-first patterns.
Don't use amber as a fill: warmth is a point, not a plane (the 10% Warmth Rule).
